identity_and_authentication_contract.role_policy: REFEREE is required by default; a future consumer may explicitly allow exact current player roles, never inferred from payload or match actor
identity_and_authentication_contract.authentication: request carries credential_id and authentication_proof; foundation verifies them through an injected deterministic RefereeAuthorityAuthenticator and records authenticator/key version
identity_and_authentication_contract.authenticator_boundary: production defines a fail-closed verifier capability interface only; credential/key lookup and signature verification are supplied by the trusted host, while deterministic fake verification exists only in CPU tests
identity_and_authentication_contract.signature_binding: proof covers protocol/schema, role, subject, credential/key version, operation, declaration kind, decision/rack identity, revision, state hash, expiry, nonce, idempotency key and canonical payload bytes
identity_and_authentication_contract.failed_authentication: fail closed before proposal/final state, revision, journal, receipt or audit mutation

request_schema.payload: exact canonical JSON object string; duplicate keys, arrays/scalars, unknown consumer keys, noncanonical whitespace/order and over-limit bytes fail closed
request_schema.declaration_kind: opaque allowlisted consumer kind; foundation does not interpret foul, frozen, push, confusion, off-table or stalemate truth
request_schema.rack_identity: nonempty current rack identity supplied by runtime authority; exact match required
request_schema.expiry: strictly current_authority_tick <= expires_at_authority_tick and bounded lifetime; expiry checked before authentication commit and on final
request_schema.nonce: nonempty bounded replay identity included in proof and retained receipt
request_schema.idempotency: nonempty <=128 bytes and bound into authenticated bytes

consumer_policy_registry.purpose: future rule consumers register an immutable declaration policy without granting the foundation rule-classification authority

proposal_final_state_machine.proposal: authenticated PROPOSE stages exactly one live proposal bound to declaration kind, actor role/subject, decision/rack/revision/hash, expiry and canonical payload; proposal is not a final referee fact
proposal_final_state_machine.final: authenticated FINAL_DECLARE must reference the exact live proposal decision/kind/rack and revalidate current revision/state hash/expiry; it commits one final declaration and consumes the proposal
proposal_final_state_machine.cancel: authenticated CANCEL_PROPOSAL must be authorized for the same proposal subject/role unless a future consumer explicitly allows referee override; consumes proposal without producing a final declaration
proposal_final_state_machine.separation: PROPOSE ACK has final_declaration_committed=false; only FINAL_DECLARE ACK has final_declaration_committed=true
proposal_final_state_machine.consumer_boundary: foundation stores opaque declaration record; no GameRuntime rule, MatchState, BIH, rack, physics, ShotFacts or adjudication mutation occurs
proposal_final_state_machine.atomicity: candidate state, revision, proposal/final journal and receipt commit together or all roll back; an injected storage-commit failure seam exists for CPU proof and cannot be selected by production input
proposal_final_state_machine.reset: runtime/ruleset/rack reset invalidates live proposal, authentication nonce and retained idempotency receipt; stale requests never resurrect

ack_journal_and_readback.exact_retry: byte-equivalent authenticated request returns original ACK with zero additional revision/journal/receipt/nonce mutation
ack_journal_and_readback.conflict: same idempotency key or nonce with any changed authenticated field fails closed
ack_journal_and_readback.audit_journal: append-only CPU journal records authentication outcome only for accepted commits, authority identity, operation, kind, decision/rack/revisions/hash, payload digest and proposal/final state; no secret/proof bytes exposed
ack_journal_and_readback.automation_readback: headless get_referee_authority_state exposes protocol version, live proposal metadata, latest final declaration metadata and audit digest; never credentials, proof bytes or inferred physics
ack_journal_and_readback.bad_input_readback: malformed or unauthenticated requests do not create authority state visible in readback

implementation_allowlist.cmake_strategy: add the new protocol cpp to BILLIARDGL_CORE_SOURCES and add one headless BilliardsRefereeAuthorityProtocolTests target only; no GPU, runner, application, renderer or product UI target changes
